abilities.description:
Gives +50 attack speed and +15% movement speed to nearby allies for 6 seconds. For the first 1.5 seconds allies are immune to slows.

Radius: 1200

Grants 15 movement speed and 2.5 health regeneration to allies.

Radius: 1200
Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.

additionalInformation: The item's attributes grants the following additional bonuses:
96 mana, 0.4 mana regeneration and 0.8% flat base magic resistance.
11.2 main attack damage to universal heroes.
name: Boots of Bearing
description: Resplendent footwear fashioned for the ancient herald that first dared spread the glory of Stonehall beyond the original borders of its nascent claim.
